title: lore link membership checks against the resolved task's aliases (post-0.15.1)
description: From the #756 round-1 verdict (LCLI-809), S3. containsTaskReference in src/commands/link.ts compares only against the strings already stored in tasks:, never against the resolved detail's aliases. Linking LCLI-5 when the doc already lists its alias OLD-1 reports added and stores a duplicate. Compare against the resolved id plus aliases by referenceKey.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Linking a task by id when the doc already lists one of its aliases reports already-linked and writes nothing, with a test red without the change
